status: EXPLORATORY - no prereg, no decision rule, no verdict. Nothing here may be described as a verdict.

constants.stencil: cell (r,d) = Delta^(d+1) of pi(2^.) at r; lean/Construction.lean tableFrom + lean/Zeros.lean dyadicRow
constants.statistic_p: p_k = |c_k| / sum_j |c_j|, c_k = -2 Re z_k; H = -sum p log p (natural log); Neff = exp(H)
constants.statistic_q: q_k = |z_k| / sum_j |z_j|; H_z and Neff_z the same way
constants.participation_ratio: PR = (sum_k |c_k|)^2 / sum_k |c_k|^2, and its |z| twin; a second effective-count estimator
constants.mode_pi: Z_k(r,d) = sum_j (-1)^j C(d+1,j) Ei(rho_k*(r-j)*ln2); matches O34's osc
